tei:div.tei:p: )$ ༄༅// chos dang chos ma yin par rnam par 'byed pa'i gtam chen po zab mor rlom pa'i

nang don 'khrul par ngo sprod par byed pa dgongs gcig grub mtha'i spyi chings bzhugs// ༄༅/ /swasti/ tshul rol phyogs zhes nyer mi bzung*// pha rol phyogs zhes ring mi 'dzin// phyogs lhung med par snyoms pa yi// brtse chen thub dbang rgyal gyur cig ༈ /byang gi phyogs 'dir chos min pa// dam chos ltar brdzus 'byams klas 'gyur// de tshe bzod par ma 'tshal te// bstan la bsams nas ngo bsrung sogs// mi bya gnas lugs brjod par bya/ ༈ /bdag ni byis pa'i dus nyid nas// ding sang zab mor grags pa yi// chos lugs rnams dang de 'dzin byed// skyes bu rnams la phyogs lhung gis// rmongs zhen gyi ni mos pa yod// de tshe de yi chos gang zag /kun la brtag dpyad 'dris par byas// dus der de yi chos dang ni// gang zag bcas pa'i skyon yon kun// gnas tshul don dang mthun par rtogs// gnas tshul de ni ji ltar na// sangs rgyas bstan las phyir gyur pa'i// bon dang mu stegs 'dra la min// de lta'i mtshan nyid mthong bas na// rmongs zhen mos pa log par gyur/ ༈ /dang po'i log par mos pa de// tshad mas bsal tshul gzhan rnams la// bstan na zang zing la gnod pas// de skad khyod kyis ma smra zhes// zang zing gnyer ba 'ga' yis zer// 'on kyang bdag gi bsam pa la// dad can log par bslu thabs 'dis// 'og nas 'og tu 'dren rtogs pa// khong du bzung bar ma thub ste// blo nas gang shar bla rdol gyur/ ༈ /de tshe gzhan lugs ngan pa rnams// mi dgag btang snyoms bya rigs zer// chos log btang snyoms 'jog pa ni// tshul ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad// chos min chos ltar snang ba la// dam chos min par ma brjod na// chos spang pa yi sdig 'gyur zhes// mdo rgyud kun tu ston pas gsungs/ ༈ /dam chos yin min the tshom du// gyur tshe btang snyoms 'jog min nam// zhe na chos min chos min pa'i// sgro 'dogs chod tshe btang snyoms su// 'jog dang lus pa gar srid de// the tshom tshad mas bsal zin to// chos min na yang skyon brjod pas// rnam smin sdug bsngal mi skyed dam// zhe na chos min pa la yang*// bsam pa kun dkris kun slong nas// sbyor ba skyon min skyon nyid du// brjod cing mthar thug pha rol la// gnod bskyed rnam smin lci 'gyur kyang*// byams dang snying rjes kun bslang nas// sbyor ba skyon nyid skyon nyid du// brjod cing mthar thug rang gzhan rgyud// rmongs pa'i dri ma sel nus pa'i// dgag pas bsod nams thob pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan la phan par gsungs/

༈ /kha cig zab mo'i rgyud mthong tshe// gal te mos par ma gyur na// chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa// dran pas len par gdams pa bzhin// 'dir yang dam chos ltar snang ba// mthong tshe bsam mi khyab dran gyi// sgo nas chos su len pa na// nyes min legs pa 'byung ngo zhes// de gnyis mtshungs pa ma yin pas// 'di len nyes pa bskyed tshul bshad// dper na lha chen po yi rgyud// mthong tshe bsam mi khyab dran gyi// sgo nas lung de tshad ma ru// zhen te dngos su len pa na// lung don byed po tshad ma yi// skyes bur zhen nas gus btud na// shugs kyis skyabs su blangs pa yin// de tsho gzhan gyi ston pa dang*// bstan la skyabs su song ba'i phyir// rang gi ston sogs skyabs gnas su// bzung ba'i dam bca' las cher nyams/ ༈ /kha cig rgyud dang rgyud byed po// kun kyang sangs rgyas pa dag gis// bstan dang ston pa yin snyam nas// 'khrul phyir skyabs gnas 'khrul pa yi// nyes pa de yang mi 'ongs zer// 'on te 'khrul yang 'jug yul la// mi bslu thob par nus na ni// de lta'i nyes pa med na yang*// 'dir ni 'khrul las 'jug pa'i yul// mi thob phyir na skyon spong 'khrul// mdor na bdag ni log 'tsho'i phyir// rdzun rgyab rdzun gyis ma brten pas// rdzun mas gshis dang bzod par 'os/ ༈ /da ni thar pa 'dod pa dag /yang dag lta ba gces pa'i phyir// lta la nor ba mchis pa 'ga'// 'khrul pa nyid du ngo sprod gdab// de yang sangs rgyas pa dag gi /grub mtha' smra ba bzhi po la// rang rang dbu mar 'dod pa yi// grub pa'i lta ba bzhi ru yod// lta ba de bzhir ma gtogs pa'i// lta de sangs rgyas pa yis spong*/ ༈ /lta yul de yang gangs can pa// mthun par 'khor 'das byed po yi// sems nyid der ni lta byed lo// 'ching grol byed po sems nyid du// sangs rgyas pa yi lugs la min// ngo mtshar can 'gas sgrogs zhes grags/

༈ /las kyi kun slong sems yin pas// de la byed po'i tha snyad zhig /sbyar phyir phyi pa'i lugs min lo// slong byed yin pas byed po yi// brda don sbyor na ha cang thal// las kyi byed po sems yin pas// 'ching grol byed por sems 'gyur na/ mu stegs kyi mngon brjod/ /ma khyab la sogs skyon gsum gnas// lta po de yang bod 'ga' zhig ༈ /snang stong 'gag med lhun grub pa'i// da lta'i shes 'dis bltas pa'i tshe// blta bya'ang da lta'i rang rig lo// da lta shes pa rang mtshan pa// rgyu rkyen las bskyed lhun grub min// yod phyir mi 'gag rtag pa min// da lta'i shes kyis da lta'i shes// bltar rlom blta bya lta byed kun// rnam rtog yin gyi rang rig min// de ltar bltas pa'i lta ba yang*// dbang phyug chen por gyur kha cig /gshis la skye ba med bzhin du// gdangs ni 'gag med 'char ba yin// gdangs kyi 'gag pa med pa de// snying rje chen po'i rtsal du shar// shar ba de yang gshis nyid kyi// stong nyid ngang du 'jug pas na// stong nyid snyeng rje snang stong dag /zung 'jug phyag chen blta ba lo// skye ba med pa skye ba ru// 'char ba srid pa ma yin no// skye med skye ba la ltos nas// skye med skye bar skye zhe na// ltos bcas phyir na rang bzhin gyi// ma grub phyir na skyes tsam yang*// mi srid de phyir skye med ni// skye ba'i ngo bor ga la 'char// dbu ma pa rnams skye ba dang*// mi skye la sogs kun rdzob chos// ji srid rnam gzhag byed pa na// 'jig rten dang ni bstan bcos lugs// thad sor 'jog pa ma gtogs pa// skye med skye bar khas len sogs// bden gnyis rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir// zhal gyi bzhes pa'i gnas skabs med// so skye'i rnam shes gsal ba'i cha// 'phags pa'i ye shes snying rje cher// 'char na de gnyis gcig pa'am// tha dad tshul gyis 'char ba yin// dang po ltar na de gnyis ni// yul dus rang bzhin gcig mi srid// gnyis pa tha dad 'brel yod dam// 'brel med gang gis 'char ba yin// dang po ltar na rnam shes dang*// ye shes tha dad de byung gi

/'brel med gnyis pa ltar na yang*// rta la ba lang cis mi 'char// gshis kyis ma 'gags ma skyes pa'i// stong nyid 'dus ma byas de dang*// gdangs kyi skye la rigs 'dra yang*// gnas skabs 'gag med 'dus byas gnyis// zung 'jug gcig pa nyid srid na// bum pa dang ni nam mkha' gnyis// gcig tu'ang zung 'jug cis mi 'thad// de gnyis gcig tu 'jug tshul la// da dung 'di ltar dpyad par bya// khyad gzhi gshis kyis ma skyes par// khyad chos mdangs kyi skye ba de// gcig tu 'jug pa de yi tshe// khyad chos gdangs kyi 'gag med de// khyad gzhi de dang gcig nyid du// 'gyur ram mi 'gyur gang yin 'dri// 'gyur na skye ba skye med du// 'gyur ba shes byar mi srid de// skyes pa'i skye ba zhig na yang*// skye ba skye med gyur min phyir// mi 'gyur gcig tu 'jug lugs med// yang na khyad gzhi gdangs skye dang*// khyad chos gshis kyi skye med gnyis// gcig tu 'jug na'ang skyon 'di gnas/ ༈ /'ga' zhig da lta'i shes pa la// stong pa'i cha dang gsal ba'i cha// gnyis yod phyir na gshis nyid kyi// skye med dang ni gdangs 'gag med// rang grub skyon brjod gnod med zer// shes pa rang mtshan gcig nyid la// rdzas kyi stong gsal cha gnyis med// cha gnyis blo yi ldog pa yin// stong gsal cha gnyis yod chug kyang*// skye med skye ba'i phyogs chos min// skye med skye bar sgrub pa la// phyogs chos tshad ma gcig kyang med// des na skyon spong ngal bar zad// blo gros rgan por ma gyur rnams// phyag chen don yang 'di ltar ston// phyag rgya che de med min te// 'khor 'das rten phyir yod grub lo// phyag rgya che des 'khor 'das kun// rten byed min tshul bshad par bya// theg chen lugs la kun gzhi yi// rnam par bzhag pa 'di lta ste// rnam smin sa bon zag med khams// gsum du bshad la dang po gnyis// 'khor ba'i rten gzhi byed par gsungs// gsum pa mya ngan 'das kyi rgyu// rgyas 'gyur rigs sogs rten byed pa'i// skye mched drug po mthun mong ba// min pa'i khyad par chos sku yi// rgyu mthun nyid du gsungs pa yin// kun gzhis 'khor ba rten tshul yang*// kun 'byung 'du byed khams gang gi

/sa bon tshul gyis brten pa yin// khams gsum sdug bsngal gsum sogs kyi// rnam smin tshul gyis brten pa yin// thos bsam sgom pa la sogs pas// bag chags rim gyis sad pa ni// zag med khams la mya ngan 'das// bskyed bya skyed byed nyid du bstan// des na 'khor 'das brten pa yi// rnam gzhag kun gzhi nyid la gyis// phyag chen rten gzhir byed pa sogs// thub pa'i dbang po'i dgongs pa min// sngags su phyag rgya chen po dang*// 'khor lo tha ma'i gshegs snying dang*// 'khor lo bar par sher phyin sogs// dgongs gcig ston tshul khyad par yin// de las rang bzhin sher phyin gyis// 'khor 'das gang yang mi brten te// 'khor 'das la sogs spros tshogs kun// rang bzhin gdod nas dben phyir ro// des na stong nyid dgag tsam la// brten na rten gzhi ma grub la// chos rnams thams cad brten par thal// de lta na ni thug med 'gyur/ ༈ /kha cig stong pa nyid de ni// chos kun 'byung ba'i sgo yin phyir// rang bzhin stong nyid sher phyin yang*// 'khor 'das kun gzhir 'thad do zer// bshad mod de yi dgongs pa ni// stong nyid yin phyir 'khor 'das kun// 'byung la gegs yod ma byas pas// stong nyid la ni brten zhes 'dogs// de lta na yang stong nyid kyis// dngos su brten pa'i rgyu dang ni// 'khor 'das brten pa'i 'bras bur ni// ma byas ltos nas bzhag tsam yin// rnam gzhag 'di yang drang don tsam// nges pa'i don gyi dbang byas nas// rang bzhin stong nyid sher phyin la// chos kun 'byung ba med par gsungs// rten dang brten pa'i spros pa kun// rang bzhin sher phyin sgrib byed yin// des na zhib mor ma bsams pa'i// rgol pa'i lan gdab nor bar zad// de bzhin bde gshegs snying pos kyang*// 'khor ba brten min sgrib bral gyis// sgrib pa brten pa mi srid de// nam mkha' sprin sngon mi brten bzhin// snying po sgrib bral de nyid kyis// sgrib bral myang 'das gnyis pa zhig

/rten dang brten par mi 'jog ste// rang ngo sgrib pa bral ba la// sgrib bral gzhan la mi ltos phyir// gshegs snying 'khor 'das brten ma yin// de bzhin phyag rgya chen po yang*// chos nyid kun gyi mchog nyid dang*// bde gshegs snying po yin pa'i phyir// 'khor ba'i gnas pa ngan pa kun// len pa'i rten du ga la rung*// mya ngan 'das pa mthar thug ni// phyag rgya chen po yin pa'i phyir// rang la rang nyid mi brten te// rang gis rang nyid phrag pa ru// zhon nas 'gro ba yod dam ci// gzhan yang brten pa rten tsam gyis// brten de der yod mi 'grub ste// shes pa skad cig snga ma rnams// shes pa phyi ma'i rten yin kyang*// snga ma'i shes pa phyi ma'i dus// yod pa min bzhin go bar gyis// yang na shes pa snga phyi rnams// rtog pa phan tshun brten pa'i phyir// shes pa phyi ma rten nyid dang*// snga ma brten par 'jog na yang*// phyi ma snga mar yod mi dgos// rten dang brten pa'i rnam gzhag dang*// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la// bskyed bya skyed byed mi dgos la// ltos pa tsam gyis rung ba ni// dbu ma chen po'i dgongs pa yin// gzhan yang phyag rgya chen po ni// yod na mi rtag pa nyid kyi// mi rtag pa yi phyag chen des// 'khor 'das rgyun gyis rtag pa gnyis// brten na mi rtag pa yis ni// rtag pa brten par byed mi dgos// gzhan yang phyag rgya chen po de// rgyal bas ma gzigs yod min zer// phyag rgya che de don dam bden// mthar thug yin phyir rgyal bas gzigs// de ma gzigs na bdud tshogs las// gang gis rgyal bar nus pa yin// des na phyag rgya chen po de// bde chen bden par yod pa'i phyir// sangs rgyas gzigs pa 'dir ma log /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs na// yod pa min pa de la'ang grub// dper na kun rdzob don dam pa'i// bden par sangs rgyas kyis ma gzigs// de phyir don dam bden pa ni// kun rdzob nyid du yod ma yin// 'khrul pa'i kun rdzob sangs rgyas kyis// ma gzigs na yang khyod nyid kyis// yod par 'dod pas khyab pa bud// gal te 'khrul pa'i kun rdzob ni// sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs she na// kun rdzob snang tsam steng 'di yi// yod med bden dang bden min sogs// 'khrul pa'i dri ma thams cad pa// 'khrul rgyu'i ma rig log pa'i tshe// 'khrul pa gzigs par mi 'gyur te// rab rib log pa'i skra bzhin no/

༈ /'ga' zhig rang bzhin 'od gsal sems// sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs zhes// mdo sde las gsungs de yi phyir// phyag chen de yang ma gzigs zer// de don spros pa'i mtshan ma ru// ma gzigs pa la dgongs te gsungs// sgras zin ltar na rdzogs sangs rgyas// rang blo rang la lkog gyur 'gyur// de bzhin phyag rgya chen po de// 'gal 'du min phyir zung 'jug pa'i// dbu ma'i lam de phyag chen zer// 'gal ba 'du ba ma yin pas// 'brel 'du'i zung 'jug bsams na yang*// 'brel 'du'i zung 'jug la sogs pa// dbu ma'i lta sgom ga la yin// spyir yang gzhi lam dbu mas ni// phyag chen don la snyegs par dka'// 'bras bu'i dbu ma gang yin pa// phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid par// stong pa'i cha nas dgongs pa ni// mthun tsam srid kyang phyag rgya che// mtshan nyid pa ru 'chad dka' ste// rnal 'byor bram ze chen po yis// phag dang glang po'i dpes gsungs pa'i// don de myong ba can la dris// des na phyag rgya chen po ni// med min 'khor 'das kun rten dang*// yod min rgyal bas ma gzigs dang*// yod med mi 'gal de gnyis kyang*// dbu ma'i lam 'dir zung 'jug gcig /ces pa'i nges don dug bzhin spong*/ ༈ /sngags tshul ltar ston kha cig gis// lta ba'i rnam par 'jog pa la// khyab byed kun tu bzang po yi// khyab bya mkha' klong yangs pa'i phyir// kun khyab gdal bar blta'o zer// khyab byed khegs na khyab bya khegs// khyab bya grub na khyab byed grub// 'di ni khyab bya khyab byed kyi// rnam par gzhag bya 'jog byed yin// gzhan du khyab bya yangs dog gis// de yi khyab byed yin pa dang*// min pa'i rnam gzhag byed pa sogs// blun pos rnam rtog rgyu mtshan ci// skabs 'gar kun bzang 'khor 'das la// khyab byed khyab par smra bzhin du// kun tu bzang po de nyid ni// 'khor 'das gang gi'ang ma bsdus sogs// nang 'gal 'brel med ci yang brjod// ston pa kun bzang rtag dngos sogs// dpal ldan grags pas bkag zin to// gzhan yang kun bzang rang mtshan de// gcig tu grub bam du mar 'grub// gcig yin kun la rjes 'gro na// byed bcas byed med gang gis 'gro// byed la sems byung 'du byed dang*// ldan min 'du byed gang gis 'gro// sems byung 'du byed kyis 'gro na// kun bzang mya ngan 'das pa la// rjes su 'gro bar mi 'gyur te// bem shes ldan min 'du byed kyis// mya ngan 'das pa de nyid ni// sems dang sems byung dben phyir ro// ldan min 'du byed kyis 'gro na// kun bzang bems po shes pa la// rjes su 'gro bar mi 'gyur te// bems shes ldan min 'du byed kyis// rnam pa kun tu dben pa yin// byed pa med par rjes 'gro na// rjes 'gro ming tsam nyid du zad// des na rang mtshan gcig nyid kyis// bsal ba kun la khyab pa ni// phyi rol pa yi rnam gzhag ste// sangs rgyas pa la 'di 'dra med// 'ga' zhig nam mkhas dngos kun la// ji ltar khyab bzhin 'dir khyab lo// nam mkha' yod par sems pa yang*// blun po'i rnam par rtog pa yin// med dgag kun la khyab rung na// ri bong rwa spus ci ma khyab// 'on te du mas rjes 'gro na// sems can thams cad rgyud la yang*// kun bzang khyab par thal ba las// kun bzang sems can shes rgyud dang*// ma 'dres gdod nas grol ba yi// mgon po 'od mi 'gyur yin par// khyod rang 'dod pa ma yin nam/

༈ /yang na lhun gyis grub pa yi// ngang nas lta bar byed do lo// rtag pa lhun gyis grub pa dang*// byed pa mi rtag gnyis bsdoms nas// lta ba'i las shig ga la srid/ ༈ /'ga' zhig sangs rgyas go 'phang yang*// ar sangs ye nas med pa la// med par ngo shes lta ba yin// med par thag chod 'bras bur btags// 'di lta'i rtogs pa thob pa na// lta sgom spyod 'bras stor ro zer// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ni// med par mu stegs kha cig 'dod// ar sangs ye sangs phyal sangs sogs// bon po rnams kyis tha snyad yin// med pa mthong du mi rung la// med par rlom pa log rtog yin// med nges 'bras bur btags pa la// thar 'dod dgos pa gang yang med// lta sgom stor sogs tshig dron yin// des na lta ba zhes pa dang*// bdag med gnyis kyis shes rab de// thos bsam sgom las byung ba yi// lhag mthong nyid la 'jug pa yin// yang dag pa yi lta ba ni// skyon med sar zhugs rnams la yin// nang du mnyam gzhag sems kun la// bod rnams lta bar ming 'dogs 'khrul/ ༈ /'ga' zhig da lta'i shes pa 'di// rtogs na sangs rgyas ma rtogs na// sems can nyid du 'jog pa'i phyir// rtog pa'i gshis la lta'o zer// da lta'i shes pa bdag gnyis kyi// 'dzin pa bral lam ma bral ba'i// shes pa gang gis rtogs pa yin// bdag 'dzin gnyis bral shes pa ni// rtogs bya rtogs byed rtogs pa gsum// bral phyir da lta'i shes pa la// rtogs par byed pa ma yin no// bdag 'dzin can gyi shes pa ni// shes pa rang la rtogs byed kyang*// grol ba thob la mi phan te// phag pa'i

dud 'gro rgyud kyi rang rig bzhin// da lta so skye'i shes pa 'di// sa thob yan du mi 'gro na// rtogs tsam rig tsam myong ba ni// sangs rgyas nyid du ci ste 'gyur// so skye'i shes 'di sems can gyi// shes par gnas na 'di rtogs kyang*// sangs rgyas mi 'gyur sems can gyi// shes pa de nyid yin phyir ro// so skye'i shes pa sangs rgyas kyi// mkhyen pa yin na ma rtogs kyang*// sems can nyid du mi 'gyur gyi// de nyid sangs rgyas yin phyir ro// da lta'i shes pa 'di nyid la// rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par gyis// sangs rgyas sems can bzang ngan du// 'byed cing da lta shes pa la// sangs rgyas dang ni sems can gyi// bzang ngan gang yang med do zer// gdon gyis bslad pa'i tshig ltar bcol/ ༈ /kha cig snang tsam tshad grub tu// smra zhing de yi stong nyid du// bdag tshad bden tshad la sogs pa// khegs pa'i stong pa de nyid la// lta ba byed pa yin no lo// gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma kun// tshad min don dam bden par bslu// de phyir gnyis snang la sogs pa// ji srid sel bar ma byas par// gnyis med ye shes mngon mi 'gyur// bdag tshad bden tshad ma bkag kyang*// bdag 'dzin bden 'dzin bag chags bcas// khegs pas grol ba thob pa yin/ ༈ /lugs de'i lta ba skyong tshul yang*// rtag tu 'dzin stangs shugs drag zer// rnam rtog bral ba'i rnal 'byor la// 'dzin stangs shugs drag med pa'i phyir// lta ba sgom pas ci ltar skyong*// des na 'di yi 'khrul pa'i cha// rong ston shes bya kun rig sogs// mkhyen bzang mang pos sun phyung bas// 'dir yang brjod par ma byas so// lta sgom 'khrul par ston pa yi// 'jam dpal nag po la sogs pa// rje btsun yin min the tshom za// sangs rgyas gsungs dang 'gal ba'i tshig /su yis smras kyang tshad ma min/ ༈ /'ga' zhig gzung 'dzin spros sogs kun// da lta'i shes pa'i steng nyid du// blo las 'das par 'jog go lo// gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtshan ma kun// da lta'i shes pa'i blo ngo na// gnas phyir blo las 'das mi srid// blo la gnas kyang blo 'das su// 'jog thabs tshur shog ston par gyis// khyu mchog mgrin par zhon bzhin du// dug sbrul mgrin par zhon nus sam/

༈ /la las snang tsam gang du yang*// ma grub cir yang mi 'dzin par// lta la mnyam par gzhag go lo// snang tsam yul du grub pa'i phyir// snang tsam gang du'ang ma grub pa// mngon sum nyid kyis bsal ba yin// shes pa'i yul gyi snang cha rnams// ting nge 'dzin dang rtsa rlung gi /byed bcings rdzas sam gnyid stug dus// ma gtogs rang gar 'gag ma yin// mdor na snang tsam snang ba ltar// ma grub pa ru rtogs pa ni// bzung med rtogs pa yan chod la// yin gyi so skye phal pa min// 'dzin byed shes pas snang ba tsam// mi 'dzin na ni snang bar 'gal// 'dzin na cir yang mi 'dzin par// 'jog sogs tshig la rdzun zol yod/ ༈ /kha cig rgyud la gang shar ba// shar tsam nyid nas rang grol du// lta bar byed pa yin no lo// so skye ngan pa sbrul gdug lta'i// rgyud la gang shar rang ga ru// rang grol yin snyam 'jog pa na// yid la ci char rang la dris// gang shar gang dran byed phod dam/ ༈ /kha cig ka dag med pa dang*// lhun grub ye nas yod pa gnyis// ngo bo dbye ba med pa'i gshis// chos kyi sku la blta'o zer// yod med ngo bo gcig mi srid// so skyes chos sku blta mi nus// 'di kun 'khrul par shes par gyis// sngon byon bka' gdams man ngag pas// ngo bo nyid med dbu ma yi// man ngag bzhin du ma rtog dang*// chos sku gnyis ka rang stong du// mnyam par gsungs pa'i don de nyid// rje btsun zla 'od gzhon nu yi// tshogs chos rnams las gsungs pa yang*// sngon gyi dus su legs bshad de// deng sang nyes bshad 'di 'drar gyur// nyes par gyur tshul 'di lta ste// rtsa nyon nye nyon la sogs pa'i// rnam par rtog pa thams cad pa// ye shes nyid du krong nger bskyed/ ༈ /lam mer khyer 'di gsang sngags ltar// yin cing dwags po'i dgongs pa yang*// 'di kho bzhin du gnas so zer// rje btsun dwags po'i bzhed min pa// dwags po'i bzhed dang bsres pa ni// ston na bzhed de ji ltar 'gyur// phyi sa lha yi bdud rtsi la// bsres na ro de ci ltar 'gyur// rje btsun dpal ldan sgam po pas// rnam rtog chos skur mi bzhed par// lam rim thar rgyan nyid du gsal/

༈ /'ga' zhig rnam rtog chos sku ni// min na gsang sngags bla med du// rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog gi /gnyen por gsungs pa'ang mi 'thad 'gyur// de bzhin rgyu yi theg par yang*// sgrib pa ma spangs rang dag sogs// gsungs de'ang 'thad par mi 'gyur zhes// cal gyi sgra bzhin ku cor byed// sngags nas rnam rtog la sogs pa// rnam rtog nyid kyi gnyen po ru// gsungs pa'i rnam par rtog pa de// rnam rtog min gyis ye shes yin// dper na dug ni sman nyid du// gsungs tshe dug ni sngags nyid kyis// bcom nas sman du 'gyur ba yin// de tshe dug min sman yin pas// dug gi ngo bor gnas pa med// de bzhin rnam par rtog pa sogs// lam zab sgom pa'i ye shes kyis// spangs par byas pa'i 'od gsal sems// rnam rtog gnyen por gsungs pa yin// nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde las// sgrib tshogs rang bzhin gyis stong phyir// gdod nas rnam par dag pa la// dgongs nas ma spangs rang dag ces// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'ang de bzhin no/ ༈ /de lta'i dgongs dang ldem dgongs la// 'bras bu'i theg pa phra zhing zab// 'bras bu'i theg pa der ltos nas// rgyu yi theg pa phra zab min// 'on kyang rgyu yi theg pa la// dgongs dang ldem dgongs yod tshul bshad// de yang sbyin las ldem dgongs te// ser sna la sogs 'phel byed lnga// tshul khrims la sogs ldem dgongs ni// 'khrig sogs lnga yi byang chub rgyur// gsungs pa lta bu shin tu mang*// des na rgyu yi theg par yang*// don gzhan du ni 'dren dgos pa'i// ldem dgongs de ltar bshad dka' na// 'bras bu'i theg pa las 'byung ba// ldem dgongs bshad pa shin tu dka'// des na rgyud sde'i sgra don rnams// shes 'dod rgyud sde che kun gyi// shes thabs ma lus shes par byos// shes nas rgyud sde tshul bzhin slobs// tshul bzhin shes pa de yi tshe// ldem dgongs dngos bstan sgras zin du// rnam par rtog pa ldog par 'gyur/

༈ /deng sang bod la gnod pa yi// rgyud sde'i ldem dgongs dngos bstan ltar// 'chad cing 'dzin pa'i lugs ngan rnams// sngon nas sprul pa'i lo paṇa dang*// chos rgyal kun gyis mgrin sdebs nas// dgag pa'i rjes su mi 'brangs bar// gti mug rdzun can rjes 'brangs ba// bskal par gsor mi rung bar go ༈ /kha cig da lta'i shes pa 'di// ye sangs rgyas pa yin pa'i phyir// yin lugs shes bzhin skyong ngo lo// sems can gyis ni shes pa 'di// ye sangs rgyas pa nyid yin na// sems can shes par ga la 'gyur// yin na yin pas skyong mi dgos// de nyid yin pas chog phyir ro// ci nas sems can shes pa 'di// rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub pa'i// sems kyi rdo rje yin pa dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin grang na// spang gnyen rnam bzhag byed pa yi// shes kun dgos pa med par thal// sems can shes pa de nyid ni// ye nas rdzogs sangs rgyas yin phyir// 'dod na sems can thams cad kun// 'bad pa med par grol bar 'gyur/ ༈ /sems can rnams kyis shes pa 'dir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngo bo dang*// rang bzhin thugs rje sku gsum gyi// grub bde rdzas gcig yin no zer// ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum// sku gsum nyid du sgra sbyor ba// 'phags yul gsung rabs brda la med// ngo bo rang bzhin sgra yang zlos// des na sems can shes pa la// sku gsum tshang dang sku gsum yin// smra sogs gsar du bcos par snang*// rgyud sde khungs thub 'ga' shas su// rnam par rig tsam khyad par la// sku gsum po dang sbyar ba yi// drang don tshig ris yod mod kyi// de yi dgongs don mtha' yas shing*// phal cher 'gyur gyi dbang gis kyang*// lhang por bde bar ma gyur pa'i// nyes pa cung zad 'byung yang srid// de phyir tshig la rton mi bya/ ༈ /spu rgyal bod kyi sa phyogs 'dir// kun rdzob pa yi chos rnams kun// rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir// kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i chos kun yang*// don dam ma 'khrul chos nyid lo// 'di la lung rig khas blangs 'gal// theg gsum gsung rab gang na yang*// rdzun pa bden pa yin pa dang*// 'khrul pa 'khrul med yin par ni// ldem por dgongs te gsungs srid kyang*// ji bzhin sgra ltar yin na ni// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis chos rnams kun// phyin ci log tu gsungs 'gyur te// dngos don bzlog ste gsung phyir ro// kun rdzob chos can chos can du// bzung nas rang stong rtags nyid du// bkod nas phyogs chos 'grub mod kyi// rtags de kun rdzob don dam dang*// 'khrul pa 'khrul med yin pa dang*// chos can chos nyid yin pa ru// sgrub la rjes su 'gro ldog 'khrul// kun rdzob don dam yin pa sogs// rang gi tshig kyang snga phyir 'gal/

༈ /kha cig kun rdzob chos rnams la// snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang*// gsal zhing stong la stong zhing gsal// rig cing stong la stong zhing rig /de gnyis dbyer med gcig par ni// lta ba lta ba mchog yin zer// snang gsal rig pa rdzas chos yin// stong pa med par dgag pa yin// de phyir yod dang med pa gnyis// dbyer med gcig pa'i lta tshul 'di// bde gshegs bka' las phyi rol yin// dngos stobs rig pa rnams dang 'gal// mdor na theg chen lta ba ni// snang dang stong pa la sogs kyi// gnyis snang nub pa'i rang bzhin yin// gnyis snang gcig tu zung 'jug dang*// gnyis snang gcig par mnyam gzhag sogs// lta dang mnyam gzhag 'khrul bcas yin/ ༈ /'ga' zhig theg chen 'phags pa yi// snang bcas mnyam gzhag khas len nas// gnyis 'dzin rgyu ltar lta'o zer// snang bcas ye shes khas len kyang*// gnyis snang sgyu ltar lta ba yin// gnyis su 'dzin pa yod gyur na// theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag min/ ༈ /kha cig theg chen 'phags pa yi// sar zhugs tshe na so skye yi// rnam par shes 'dis 'khrul snang kun// sgyu ma lta bur lta 'o zer// theg chen 'phags pa'i sa thob tshe// sgo lnga'i rnam shes gnas gyur cing*// drug pa yid kyi shes pa yang*// rang bzhin med par rtogs phyir dang*// nyon yid mngon du mi 'gyur dang*// kun gzhi'i rnam shes yul can ni// lta ba'i byed pa ma yin pas// sa der so skye'i shes pa ni// lta po min par shes par byos/ ༈ /ston pa gnyis par byed pa 'gas// lta ba'i mthar thug 'di ltar ston// tshur mthong shes pa 'di nyid la// bcos med oṃ ni swa re ba// ma yengs had der lta 'o zer// shes pa kun gyi skye 'jig cha// skyes tsam nyid nas 'jig pa la// 'jig rkyen bcos ma gzhan mi dgos// des na shes pa'i skad cig la// shes pa'i skye 'jig bcos tsam las// bcos ma gzhan pa med pa yang*// rnal 'byor thob pa'i khyad chos yin// had de ba dang oṃ swa re// tha snyad rnams kyang rang dran yin/

༈ /kha cig phyag chen lta ba ni// kun rdzob snang cha gsal tsam la// shes pa rang stong du bltas pa// shes pa nyid kyang stong nyid du// rang grol nyid du 'gro 'o zer/ ༈ /lta tshul de la so skye la// phyag chen rjes mthun pa nyid dang*// 'phags rgyud phyag chen mtshan nyid pa// gang du yang ni mi 'gyur te// so skye yang dag lta ba dang*// phyag chen lta ba rjes mthun pa// rgyud la skye bar byed pa la// dngos stobs rigs pas drangs pa yi// tshad ma skyed par byed pa dang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i byin rlabs kyis// phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa// mtshon pa'i bde stong myong ba dgos// de lta min pa'i yid dpyod kyis// kun rdzob rang stong rtogs snyam blo// tshad min blo yin phyag chen min// 'phags rgyud mnyam gzhag dbang shes lnga// nang du yang dag bsdus phyir dang*// dbang shes yin phyir yid dpyod med// yid shes dpyod pa'ang der med de// smra bsam brjod med rnal 'byor yin// kun rdzob stong pa'i yid dpyod kyis// shes pa stong par grol mi nus// stong par grol la stong nyid ni// mngon sum rtogs pa'i ye shes dgos/ ༈ /rnal 'byor grub pa 'ga' zhig kyang*// mos pa'i dbang gis 'di skad gsungs// 'khrul pa'i de nyid shes pa yis// rnam par dpyod tshe tha mal shes// rang ngo mthong tshe gsal stong dang*// 'dzin med sems su thag chod nas// cir snang chos skur lta 'o skad// 'di lan mgo snyoms rnal mar gdab// de las dang po 'di lta ste// bum pa'i de nyid shes pa yi// rnam par dpyod pas rnam 'dzin gyi// shes pa'i rang ngo rig pa'i tshe// gsal myong nyid du thag chod nas// cir snang dka' bar lta 'o mtshungs// rnal ma'i lan ni 'di yin gyis// 'khrul pa'i de nyid shes pa yi// rnam dpyod 'di la gsum du yod// ma rig pa sogs rgyu rkyen las// 'khrul pa'i de nyid shes pa yi// rnam dpyod 'di ni 'khor ba yi// nyes dmigs myang 'das phan yon sogs// rgyud la skyed par byed pa yin// 'khrul pa 'khrul ltar ma grub pa'i// de nyid shes pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// 'khrul pa'i 'dzin pa bzlog byed yin// gang la 'khrul pa'i stong nyid don// ji bzhin de nyid shes pa yi// rnam dpyod 'dis ni zad pa dang*// mi skye'i ye shes bskyed pa yin// rnam dpyod dbye ba ma phyed par// rnam dpyod tsam por 'dzin pa ni// blo gros rtsing por gsal bar mdzad// des na rnam par dpyod de yis// rnam par dpyod pa rang rgyud kyi// tha mal shes pa rang ngo de// mthong ngam gzhan gyi rgyud kyi ni// tha mal shes pa'i rang ngo mthong*// dang po ltar yang mi rung ste// rang gi rnam dpyod rtog pa yis// rang ngo'i rang rig mi mthong ste// rang rig yul la rnam rtog ni// yul can sbyor nas mthong ba min// gnyis pa ltar yang mi rung ste// gzhan gyi shes pa tha mal pa'i// rang ngo'i rang rig de nyid kyang*// gzhan gyi rtog pa'i yul min te// rang mtshan rtog pa'i yul min phyir// dpyod pas rang rig mthong bar dka'// rang ngo'i rang rig mthong ba na// shes pa'i gsal stong la sogs pa// mthong bas slar yang gsal stong sogs// sems nyid ngang du thag chod ces// tshig la'ang zlos pa'i skyon yang yod// sems kyi gsal stong tsam myong bas// gang snang chos skur lta nus na// khyi phag rnams kyang skal ldan 'gyur// tha mal shes pa zhes pa yang*// rnam shes yin na tha snyad rung*// ye shes yin na tha snyad 'gal// ye shes 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa la// tha mal sgra 'di shin tu ngan/

༈ /kha cig tshur mthong rgyud 'di nyid// gzhi lam 'bras gsum ye tshang dang*// ye nas ye lta byed do lo// dus gsum skad cig ma gcig la// mi shong rgyu dang gzhi gnyis po// don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin// tha snyad 'di 'drar 'khrul dogs yod/ ༈ /kha cig shes pa gang shar thog /bde gsal mi rtog shes pa zhig /'bol le sa le hrig ge bar// yang yang 'jog bzhin lta byed lo// gang shar shes pa de nyid ni// skyes tsam 'jig par gsal ba'i phyir// bde gsal mi rtog shes gzhan rnams// yang yang gang shar snga ma'i steng*// 'jog dang lta ru ga la nus/ ༈ /gal te skad cig gcig la ni// skad cig gzhan bzhag mi thub bden// de lta na yang shes pa yi// mtshan nyid bde gsal mi rtog par// skyes de skyes par 'jog go lo// shes pa'i mtshan nyid gsal rig yin// shes pa'i mtshan nyid bde ba min// yin na sdug bsngal btang snyoms kyi// shes pa med par thal bar 'gyur// skyes pa skyes par 'jog nus na// skyes pa yang ni rtag par 'gyur/ ༈ /kha cig so skye'i shes pa la// bde gsal mi rtog gsum po de// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum yin// ngo ma phrod par gol ba na// khams gsum ltung rgyu'ang yin no lo// sku gsum yin na khams gsum rgyur// mi srid sku gsum khams gsum du// gol byed bde gsal mi rtog pa// yin na bde gsal mi rtog pa// rnam pa kun tu spang bar gyis// ngo ma phrod sogs zol tshig yin/ ༈ /kha cig gang zag gcig gis ni// rgyud la rnam par rtog pa dang*// rtog med lhan du mi 'byung phyir// 'khrul dang ye shes dum bur btubs// dum bur gnas shing dum bur 'thud// mi g.yeng rtsol bas glod do lo// rtog pa dang ni rtog med kyi// shes pa spel mar skye na yang*// 'jug pa myur phyir dus gcig tu// skye ba lta bur snang ngo zhes// mu stegs pa dag smra ba yin// khyod kyang rjes zlos byed dam ci// tshogs drug cig car skye ba'i phyir// rtog pa dang ni rtog med gnyis// lhan cig dag tu 'byung ba yod// 'khrul ye dum bur gnas na ni// dum bur 'thud du ga la btub// 'thud dgos na ni gtub don med// rtsol ba de nyid g.yeng pa yin/

༈ /kha cig shes pa 'di ka la// ye shes bskyed phyir ngar 'don lo// gri sogs rnon por byed pa dang*// sman gyi nus pa bskyed pa la// rdzas kyi ngar 'don rung ba bzhin// bems po'i chos kyi khyad par rnams// shes la sbyar yang mtshungs pa min/ ༈ /kha cig phyag chen ye shes ni// skad cig gcig gi bdag nyid can// dper na nyer dgu'i zla ba bzhin// shar tsam nyid nas 'gags zin pas// sngar 'das don la 'jog go lo// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes ni// bde dang stong pa'i 'od gsal la// mngon sum nyid yin 'gags zin la// 'jug pa'i bcad shes ga la yin/ ༈ /de la dpe yi ye shes ni// skad cig gcig pa yin pa'i phyir// phyag chen ye shes de nyid kyang*// skad cig nyid du thal lo zer// de yi dgongs pa 'di yin te// dpe zhes de yi mthun tshul ni// don gyi ye shes khyad par ba// de nyid bde stong yin pa dang*// 'dzag bral sdom par mtshon pa la// gsum pa'i ye shes nyid kyis kyang*// bde stong nyams dang tshor bde bral// zag la gcod pa'i sgo nas mtshon// de lta na yang dpe don gyi// ye shes 'byed pa'i khyad par yod// dpe des 'dzag bde la sogs pa// mngon gyur tsam zhig 'bral byed yin// gcig shos sa bon spangs pa yis// lam gyi mchog tu ston pas bsngags// yang na dpe yi ye shes ni// don gyi ye shes de nyid dang*// dmigs rnams mthun phyir ye shes su// gdags kyi phyag chen ye shes ni// dngos nyid min gsungs dpe'i ye shes// skad cig grub kyang phyag chen gyi// ye shes skad cig cis te 'gyur// yang na dpe yi ye shes ni// rdo rje'i gsang sngags sgrub pa des// nus pa'i mthu las skal ldan gyi// rnam shes skad cig der 'gags nas// ye shes 'od zer snang na yang*// de ni skad cig cha bral te// de la dus kyi rnam dbyer med/ ༈ /kha cig phyag chen skad cig tu// mi 'dod na ni mchog mi 'gyur// bde ba'i skad cig nyi khri dang*// chig stong drug brgya phyag chen gyi// ye shes min par thal lo zer// de dag thig rlung sems gsum gyi// skad cig nyi khri chig stong gi

/'dzag pa so sor sdom pa yin// sdom byed mchog mi 'gyur ba yi// ye shes la ni skad cig med// dper na sems can phung po la// lnga ru nges pa'i ldog pa yis// sangs rgyas la yang rigs lngar bzhag /don du sangs rgyas ris med dang*// yang na sangs rgyas rigs lnga ru// ma zad rigs ni mtha' yas par// sangs rgyas rigs kyi grangs gar lang*// mdor na skad cig chos sku sogs// blun po'i 'phral dran gsar rtsom yin/ ༈ /kha cig sems dang sems byung chos// dngos po'i rdzas rigs du ma rnams// shes pa'i skad cig mar bsdus nas// blo bral ngang du bskyang ngo lo// sems dang sems byung yul dus dang*// rang bzhin rdzas tha dad pa rnams// sangs rgyas kyis kyang shes pa yi// skad cig gcig la bsdu mi nus// nus na skye 'phags la sogs pa'i// sems dang sems las byung ba yi// so so'i rdzas kyang rgyud gcig tu// bsdus shing mnyam par gzhag rung 'gyur// de 'dra shes byar srid ma yin/ ༈ /'ga' zhig dran shes tu re ba// de nyid phyag chen lta ba lo// dran pa 'das myong 'dzin pa yi// spros pa'i mtshan ma gtso che bas// stobs dang dbang por ma gyur cing*// bde stong phyag rgyas ma zin pa'i// dran shes tsam po phyag chen gyi// lta dang ye shes ga la yin// 'o na ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis// nyes drug sel ba'i gnyen po ru// spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad po yi// dran pa ting 'dzin min pa dang*// sangs rgyas pa yi dran nye sogs// spros pa'i mtshan mar thal lo na// 'du byed brgyad kyi dbye ba yi// dran pa de ni ting 'dzin rnams// sgrub byed yin gyi bsgrub bya min// sems can rnams kyi sems dang ni// sems byung dran sogs sangs rgyas sar// gnas 'gyur thob byed sangs rgyas su// gyur tshe de yi dran nye sogs// spros pa'i mtshan mar ci ste thal/ ༈ /rmongs par ston pa kha cig gis// dmigs bya snang ba de nyid ni// dmigs par byed pa'i dus nyid nas// dmigs bya rang bzhin med pa dang*// dmigs byed rang bzhin med lta bas// thad sor ngang gis 'jog go lo// gzung 'dzin rang bzhin stong nyid ni// yin kyang de ltar mkhyen gzigs pa// theg chen 'phags pa la yin gyi// so skye'i snang yul 'khrul pa'i dngos// dmigs tshe de nyid 'khrul stobs kyis// rang bzhin med par snang mi srid// blta byed so skye'i shes pas kyang*// gzung 'dzin dngos po 'dzin nyid kyi// rang bzhin med par snang blta ba'i// nyams myong tshad ma srid ma yin// gzhan yang so skye'i shes pa la// 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bskyed par// gang snang mtshan ma'i rang bzhin du// snang ba kun rdzob chos nyid yin// de la rnam par rtog pa yis// rang bzhin med par zhen na yang*// snang ba thad sor 'jog ces pa// rang gi khas blangs dam bca' bud/

༈ /kha cig deng sang 'di skad zer// 'khor ba myang 'das nyid yin dang*// mya ngan 'das kyang 'khor bar smra// 'ga' zhig de yang skyon bcas zhes// smras nas 'khor ba mya ngan 'das// yin kyang myang 'das 'khor ba ni// min zhes glang chen khrus ltar smra// de nyid 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi// don du'ang phal cher sgrogs par byed// zab mo'i rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i// 'khor 'das dbye ba med tshul bshad// rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi// sngags kyi dbu mar 'khor ba dang*// myang 'das dbyer med ces pa'i lta// gtan la 'bebs par 'dod pa na// rgya chen rnal 'byor spyod pa dang*// zab mo ngo bo nyid med du// smra ba'i dbu ma gang rung zhig /khas blangs sgo nas gsang sngags kyi// lta ba de la 'jug dgos kyis// rim pa gang yang mi shes par// sngags kyi dbu ma'i 'khor ba dang*// myang 'das dbyer med lta ba sogs// phyogs tsam shes par ga la nus// de yang zab mo'i ngo bo nyid// med par smra ba gzhir byas nas// 'di nyid la ni 'jug pa na// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gang yin pa// rdo rje'i lam du 'od gsal nas// dag pa'i zung 'jug de nyid ni// myang 'das yin gyi de nyid las// mya ngan 'das pa gzhan du med// de yi rang ngo de nyid nas// myang 'das 'das pa ma gtogs pa// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin grub pa med// shes rab zab mo de nyid kyang*// gsang sngags thabs kyis zin pa na// gsang sngags dbu ma'i lta ba yin// rgya cher rnal 'byor spyod pa ltar// gzhir byas 'di la 'jug pa na// mdor na gnas skabs gsum nyid kyi// chos nyid 'gyur med de nyid la// gsang sngags lam gyi bskyed rdzogs kyis// rang rig nyid du gsal ba la// 'khor 'das gang gis brjod gyur kyang*// de nyid mtshon pa med pa'i phyir// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// tha snyad gnyis kar 'gal ba med// don gyi gnas lugs spros bral ba'i// gnyis med e waṃ kho na yin// de lta'i shes rab gsang sngags kyi// thabs kyis zin na gsang sngags lugs// dbu ma'i lta ba 'khrul med yin/

༈ /zol gyi snying po 'ba' zhig pas// bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni// de ma thag yid yin pa'i phyir// rnam par shes pa tshogs drug po// skyed byed nyid du gnas pa ste// de yi cha shas tshogs drug la// ma 'dres cha zhig yod pa de// chos dbyings ngo bo yin pa'i phyir// blta bya'i yul yang yin no lo// bdun yid bde gshegs snying po ni// 'khrul gzhi dri ma med yid la// brten nas 'khrul pa skyes par go /ye shes rnam shes lhan cig tu// bdag rkyen gcig gis bskyed byas nas// rnam shes dang ni ye shes kyi// 'jug pa gcig tu ga la yod// rgyas 'gyur rigs dang bdun yid dang*// de ma thag pa gzhi dus kyi// mnyam nyid ye shes yin pa sogs// khyod la rang lugs nges pa med/ ༈ sa/log par smra ba kha cig ni// thogs bcas gzugs la thogs med du// longs spyod nus na snang sems gnyis// 'dres pa'i tshad kyang yin pa'i phyir// de lta'i rtogs thob rnal 'byor pas// snang sems 'dres pa'i lta ba la// mnyam par bzhag tshe lha rnams kyis// me tog mchod sogs byed do lo// rnam rig smra ba yan chad la// gang snang sems su 'dod pa'i phyir// slar yang de gnyis 'dres mi dgos// snang sems 'dres pa thams cad la// lha rdzas dag gis mchod 'gyur na// ngan song la sogs 'gro kun la// lha yi me tog gtor sogs thal// thogs bcas dag la thogs med du// bar srid sogs kyis sgrod nus kyang*// thar pa 'dod la nyer mkho med// sdig can dmyal snang 'char rnams la// mtho ris longs spyod mi dbang phyir// sdig can shi ba'i dus kyi tshe// lha yi mchod rdzas rdzun du gsal/ ༈ /kha cig de ma thag yid ni// shes pa'i rnal 'byor bzang po ni// smos ci dgos te dud 'gro sogs// tsā rir sdad tsam phyag rgya che// rgyud la skye bas ring bsrel dang*// grub rtags mngon sum ston no lo// de ma thag yid mi shes pas// 'khor ba'i rtsa bar 'jog la sogs// legs par sbyangs pa ma yin pas// mkhas pa'i bstan bcos chen po la// 'grel bshad byas pa'i rnam 'gyur yin// bem po'i nus pas dud 'gro la// phyag chen skye bar gang du bshad// dud 'gro la ni sku gzugs dang*// ring bsrel bden pa'i stobs kyis ni// 'byung na kun mkhyen ga la bden// rdo la rjes sogs las nus yin/

༈ /kha cig phyag chen lta ba ni// las nyon mtshan nyid ci 'char yang*// shar ba'i snang ba sna tshogs pa// gnas lugs rjen pa yin pa'i phyir// kun rdzob snang cha mi 'gegs shing*// mi zhen ngang nas rang gi sems// gza' gtad bral bar mtha' gol ba// ma spangs gnas lugs ngang nyid du// yin lugs shes pas lta'o lo// las nyon snang cha gnas lugs kyi// chos nyid rjen pa yin pa dang*// slar yang de nyid kun rdzob kyi// snang cha yin par rang tshig 'gal// mtha' dang gol sa ma spangs pa'i// gza' gtad bral ba smyon pa pa// lta bu'i sems 'di gnas lugs kyi// shes pa'i lta bar grol na ni// dkon mchog gsum 'di shin tu rdzun// gti mug chen pos smyo ba yi// sdig can 'di ni skyabs su grub/ ༈ /kha cig gdul bya'i mos blo la// bkri ba'i thabs su 'di ltar gsungs// grub mthas drangs shing man ngag gis// myong ba'i lta ba shin tu dman// tha mal lta ba mchog yin lo// 'di ni ji bzhin khas len na// so skye'i tha mal lta ba ni// rtsa nyon lnga pa yin pa'i phyir// de 'dra'i ngang la 'jog na ni// mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyam 'dod yin// mdor na smos pa'i lta ba rnams// 'jig tshogs lta dang mthar 'dzin lta// log pa'i lta bar song tshul brjod/ ༈ /de yang 'jig ltar song ba'i tshul// phung po lnga yi gzung 'dzin chos// bdag tu 'dzin pa mi 'gegs par// rang bzhin gyis ni grub rlom der// bdag med la sogs mi sgom par// phyag chen rang bzhin ngo bo lo// phung po lnga la ngo bor ni// rdzas grub dmigs tshul 'di 'dra ba// phyag chen nga yi khyer sogs kyi// zol gyi sgribs kyang 'jig lta las// 'da' ba med par shes par byos/ ༈ /mthar 'dzin lta bar song tshul ni// snang gzhi'i chos kun tshad grub la// de yod de yi bden tshad kyis// stong pa'i bden med de gnyis ni// mi 'gal dbu ma'i lam yin la// snang gzhi tshad grub med min dang*// de yi bden tshad yod min pa// yod med ya bral zung sbrel ba'i// rtag chad sbyar ba'i lta ba la// dbu ma'i lta de shin tu mtshar/

༈ /kha cig don byed nus pa yi// dngos po bden pa'i rdzas med phyir// de nyid bden med dngos med pas// dngos po nyid kyang dngos med du// bltas pas ngos 'dzin gdon grol lo// dngos po rdzas min zhes pa dang*// dngos por khas len byed pa 'gal// dngos po bden par med gyur kyang*// dngos med yin pa'i khyab pa 'khrul// dngos po dngos med nyid du ni// gzhi gcig steng du 'gal ba la// mi 'khrul tshad mar lta ba ni// mthar 'dzin min na mthar 'dzin ci/ ༈ /gzhan yang bden na med pa dang*// rdzun na yod par lta ba ni// sgro 'dogs skur 'debs mtha' spong lo// bden dang rdzun pa'i khyad par gyis// yod dang med par 'jog pa ni// bden gnyis rnam 'byed grub pa'i mtha'// rnam bzhag phyin ci log byed pa// mthar 'dzin lta ba'i dug yin no/ ༈ /kha cig don dam gnas tshul gyi// lta la mnyam par bzhag pa na// kun rdzob dngos po'i rgyu 'bras rnams// bden pa nyid du ma ltas na// bden gnyis zung 'jug mi 'byung bas// bden gnyis lhan du bden lta lo// dbu ma'i lta la bzhag pa na// dngos po bden par lta ba dang*// dngos po bden med nyid du yang*// lta sogs mthar 'dzin kho na yin/ ༈ /da ni log ltar song tshul bshad// so thar sdom pa'i ngo bo ni// sems tsam pa yi spong sems la// 'chad pa shin tu dman pa yin// 'o na de yi ngo bo ni// rnam rig min pa'i gzugs bya ba// nyams med rnams la dbang po dang*// ldan zhing nyams pa rnams la yang*// dbang rten zhar ba la sogs kyi// skyes bu'i gzugs su yod pa de// gang zag bzhi yis mthong ngo lo// 'khrul gtam 'di tsam 'byung ba ni// bsam gtan nyer bsdogs tsam thob pa// ldang sems gsal snang cung zad kyis// 'khrul gzhi byas pa'i yid dpyod dam// yang na shes pa 'khrul ngo yi// rmi lam lta bu'i log shes shig /mngon sum lta bur 'khrul gyur tam// 'di 'dra'i rigs can thams cad pa// log lta'i rgyu ru bde gshegs kyis// mdo sde tshangs pa'i dra bar gsungs// 'bri gung rin chen yab sras kyi// dgongs pa zab mo sangs rgyas yin// kha cig rang ngo ma shes pa'i// 'khrul de gnas skabs gsum gyi dus// gang la 'byung zhes dan dhu'i tshogs// phan tshun mu cor gleng ngo grags// 'khrul pa'i don ni rdzun pa ste// de yi thog ma tha ma'ang rdzun// de la snga phyi ga la yod// 'khrul dus ngos 'dzin byed pa sogs// lung ma bstan gyi lta bar 'gyur// kha cig phyag rgya chen po'i lta// snang ba'i ngo bo gsal tsam la// 'di la dus gsum spros pa kun// cig car bcad nas gnang ba de// dus dang bral bar lta ba las// zab pa yod re kan sogs smra// snang ba thams cad 'dus byas yin// 'dus byas thams cad 'gyur ba yin// 'gyur ba de la dus su bzhag

/dus gsum gang yang ma yin pa'i// gsal tsam snang ba'ang 'grub par dka'/ ༈ /kha cig shes pa 'di nyid la// bla mas rang ngo 'phrod par sprod// 'phrod na chos skur 'char ro lo// rang rig yod tshad rang ngo ni// mi shes mi srid de yi phyir// rang ngo 'phrod pa bla ma la// ma rag tshul 'di sngon nyid nas// blo chen rnams kyis bsal zin to/ ༈ /kha cig 'dod chags lta bu la// lta ba'i ngo ti byed pa'i tshe// phra thig srog rtsol la sogs pa// bcos sgom rgyas 'debs spangs nas ni// ma bcos chags par lta bo zer// 'dod chags la sogs dam chos su// smra ba mu stegs gsang sngags yin// mtshan mar 'dzin pa yod kyi bar// mtshan bcas bskyed rdzogs lam du bsngags// ji srid mtshan med gyur pa na// khyod kyi dug lnga ji ltar lus// sdug bsngal rgyu la thar pa zhes// bdud kyi stobs las byung ba yin/ ༈ /kha cig rdo rje theg pa yi// lam gyis phung po lhag med du// sangs rgyas sgrub phyir 'dod yon lnga// rnam rtog med par longs spyod lo// rgyud nas 'dod yon bsten pa sogs// dgongs pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa yin// 'dod pa'i yon tan gang byung ba// ci tsam longs spyod byed pa yang*// las kyi 'bras bur spyod pa yin// rdo rje 'chang gi rgyur mi 'gro// spyir yang phung po lhag med du// sangs rgyas theg pa che las bkag /rdo rje theg pa bla med du// khams drug ldan pa'i lus 'di nyid// sgrib bral byas nas ye shes sku// 'khor ba ji srid lhag bcas 'dod// 'ga' la rlung gi nus pa yis// rang lus 'ja' ltar snang ba yod// de tsam thar pa ma yin te// las gtum la sogs byed pa yis// mu stegs la yang de 'dra yod/ ༈ /kha cig ston pa sangs rgyas kyang*// 'das grongs la sogs mnga' ba'i phyir// 'chi med rig 'dzin ma grub lo// 'di ni bon gyi zer sgros yin// rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas zhes pa// 'dod lha drug gi dben gnas 'gar// gsang sngags spyod pa'i yul yod kyi// rig 'dzin gnas zhes de la brjod// gzhan du mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gnas// gnas chen so bdun la sogs pa// sprul pa'i zhing khams rnams la grags/

༈ /gzhan yang rdzogs chen lta ba ni// kun bzang thugs nyid yin phyir dang*// theg dgu'i rtse mo yin pa'i phyir// 'di las lhag pa'i lta ba med// theg brgyad la sogs lta ba ni// snying med gzhob stong 'dra'o lo// rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba'i// lta dang grub mtha'i dbye ba ni// sangs rgyas bstan la 'gar yang med// bon dang rgya nag chos lugs yin// rdzogs chen lta ba mchog gyur pa'i// sgrub byed bsgrub bya nyid dang mtshungs/ ༈ /kha cig dam pa rgya gar gyi// dam chos zhi byed lta ba yang*// pha rol phyin pa'i lta ba de// rig pa gcer mthong kho nas grol// de las thabs gzhan mi dgos lo// theg chen 'phags pa thob pa na// stong nyid kho nar snyoms 'jug na// dus ma yin par yang dag mtha'// mngon sum byas pa'i skyon yod na// so skyes thabs cha kun bkag ste// rig pa gcer mthong zhes bya ba// rig pa dwangs shing grub tsam gyis// phar phyin lta bar 'gyur ram ci/ ༈ /a ma lab ma'i gcod lugs la// ma gcig mo rang la sogs kyis// dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas dbang bskur lo// bslab pa 'cha' dang dkyil 'khor gyi// gtso bor bzhengs nas dbang bskur sogs// cho ga sangs rgyas spyod yul yin// phal pa'i dbang sogs nus pa med/ ༈ /mdor na gangs can khrod 'di ni// chos rgyal lo paṇa bka' drin che// de phyir btsan po khri srong gis// lta ba klu sgrub lugs bzhin gyis// spyod pa mkhan po'i lugs ltar slobs// bka' rtsigs 'di nyid btsan pa na// skye dgu bde legs nyid du byed// chos dang chos min dbye ba'i gtam// lta ba'i le'u dang po'o// ༈ //rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// sgrib sogs rnam par byang ba dgos// de dag byang bar byed pa la// gnyen po'i ye shes gang yin pa// gsal snang thob la sgom pa gces// de phyir sgom la nan tan gyis// bsgom par bya ba'i sgom pa yang*// zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong gi

/sgom pa rnam pa gnyis su yod// zhi gnas de ni shin sbyangs kyi// ting 'dzin rtse gcig pa yin phyir// de nyid la yang zag bcas dang*// zag med dag gi dbye ba dang*// sgom tshul la yang thun mong dang*// thun mong min pa shes par byos/ ༈ /lhag mthong de ni bdag med pa// rtogs pa'i shes rab rnam 'byed yin// de nyid la yang 'jig rten dang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbye ba dang*// sgom tshul la yang thun mong dang*// thun mong min pa shes par byos// sangs rgyas go 'phang sgrub pa la// sgom tshul 'di ltar mi shes shing*// man ngag tshad ma med bzhin du// shes pa 'di ka zhi gnas dang*// lhag mthong nyid du sgom zhes zer// zhi gnas sgom par byed pa la// yul gyi rnam g.yeng nyes dmigs su// mthong nas nye bar zhi ba dgos// lhag mthong sgom par byed pa la// chos kun spros bcas ma zhi bar// mthong nas spros med sgom pa dgos// rnam g.yeng shes pa sor bzhag 'dis// zhi lhag sgom gyi go gar chod// rnam g.yeng la sogs sgrib pa rnams// zhi lhag sgom du byed pa sogs// sangs rgyas bstan dang mi mthun pas// rgyud khungs nye ba gsar du smos// rang rgyud kho nas myong chos phyir// skal med gzhan gyi blo bar ni// 'di 'dra 'bab pa ma yin sogs// rmongs pas kun nas bslangs te brjod/ ༈ /mi dge ba yi spyod lam sogs// phyag chen sgom gyis byed do zer// phyag chen ngang nas spyod lam sogs// ting 'dzin ma thob pa la min// ting 'dzin can la sdig spyod med// sdig pa rang gi ngo bo yang*// don ldog gzhan du 'gyur med phyir// phyag chen sgom du ga la 'gro// kha cig gnas lugs phyag chen ni// btsan thabs nyid du sgom pa na// dbang gis smin dang bskyed rdzogs kyis// grol ba'i rnam gzhag mi dgos la// de las dman pa bde stong gi /phyag chen sgom pa'i dbang byas nas// smin grol phyag rgya la sogs kyis// rnam gzhag byas pa yin no lo// dbang bzhi dang ni rim gnyis la// ma brten phyag rgya chen po ni// med phyir dbang bzhi rim gnyis la// phyag rgya chen po'i ring rgyud dang*// nye rgyud dag gi khyad par yod// gnas lugs phyag chen btsan 'debs sogs// blun la grags pa'i khyad par yin/

༈ /kha cig zab mo'i dbang blangs nas// sdig spyad dam tshig ma bsrungs kyang*// thob pa gcig pus grol ba'i phyir// sgom yang de yis go chod lo// tshul bzhin dbang thob sdom ldan na// sdig spyad dam nyams mnar med ltung*// dbang tsam bskur yang sngags sdom ni// ma skyes pa yis sdig byas kyang*// dbang gis thob pa'i dam tshig ni// nyams pa med kyang gsang sngags la// co 'dri byas pa'i chos spong gis// ngan song gnas su skye ba las// nges legs thabs su ga la 'gro/ ༈ /de la kha cig rang rang gis// lta sgom sangs rgyas dgongs pa dang*// ma mthun pa yi rdzun rgyab la// nged kyi lta sgom bzang po 'di// sprul pa'i ye shes dkyil 'khor la// dbang blangs nas ni rtogs pa'i phyir// gzhan gyi myong bar mi 'dra lo// sprul pa'i 'khor lor dbang len pa'i// skal ldan yin na tshe 'di la// mchog gi dngos grub thob gyur cing*// de thob dus na rang nyid kyis// rtogs don gzhan la 'doms pa yin// kha cig mar me shel gong dang*// nyi zer rma bya'i mdongs dang ni// seng ras mig la bkab pa dang*// drag por mig gnyis btsir nas ni// 'od gsal mngon du byed do lo// mig dbang bslad pa'i snang cha rnams// med par gsal bar snang ba yi// rtog med 'khrul shes yin pa'i phyir// mngon sum ltar snang tshad ma min/ ༈ /kha cig deng sang sangs rgyas kyis// gsungs pa'i bsgom rim thams cad la// tshong 'dus 'o ma lta bu yis// bsres bslad ma byas gcig kyang med// des na gter nas 'thon pa yi// 'khrul med don zhig sgom zer lo// bod 'dir jo bo lha gcig gis// lha sa'i dkar chag ka ba las// mkha' 'gros bstan nas bton pa 'di// ma gtogs gter nas dam pa'i chos// yid brtan rung ba na gcig med// gter chos rnams ni rang bzo yin/ ༈ /kha cig dran rig shes pa kun// mi dgag mi bskyil shes pa rnams// stong pa nyid du dran tsam gyis// ma brjed phyag rgya chen po lo// shes pa thams cad kun la yang*// stong pa nyid kyi dran 'dzin sogs// thos bsam las byung shes rab kyi// rgyas 'debs tsam zhig sgom byed pa// dngos por 'dzin pa ldog byed yin// sgom pa'i stobs kyis rgyas 'debs na// dus der dran rig shes sogs kyang*// rang bzhin stong pa nyid du ni// chu la chu bzhag bzhin song bas// dran rig mi 'gag gang du lus// de lta na yang de tsam gyis// phyag chen sgom par mi 'gyur ro// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom thabs ni// yan lag drug gam rim pa lnga// bsnyen sgrub bzhi las ma gtogs pa// sgom pa'i thabs gzhan yod ma yin/

༈ /kha cig sems kyi rtsa ba ni// sems su thag chod sems nyid du// grub par rtogs pas grol lo zer// sems nyid sems su grub pa ru// 'dod cing sems tsam yan chad la// sems la rgyu rkyen rang dbang can// ma grub phyir na gzhi rtsa sogs// bral bar dbu ma'i gzhung du gsal/ ༈ /rig pa skad cig ma gcig la// byang phyogs so bdun la sogs chos// rdzogs par bsgom shing yod ces zer// skad cig gcig la so bdun sogs// sgom la rang dbang thob pa ni// 'phags chen ma gtogs gzhan la med// so skye rnams kyi shes pa ni// mtshungs ldan rnam pa lngas mtshungs kyis// nyi tshe'i shes pa kho nar zad/ ༈ /kha cig sems kyi skad cig grangs// 'dus byas yin phyir grangs shig yod// grangs de 'dzin par blos lcogs na// tshad rdzogs 'khor ba zad pa yin// ji srid grangs de ma zin pas// go rim 'khrugs pas srid 'dir 'khyams// 'di ni sgom pas grub bo lo// kye ma blun pos ci yang dran// rig pa snga mtha' phyi mtha' ni// thug med yin phyir skad cig la// grangs tshad yod par ga la 'gyur/ ༈ /deng sang sa thob 'dod pa 'ga'// klog tsam la yang rmongs pa na// nged cag shes rab gcig pus ni// bsgoms pas shes rab rkyang grol lo// theg pa che yi 'bras bu la// shes rab rkyang grol rnam gzhag med// lhag par gsang sngags la brten pa'i// sa thob dbang po smin pa'i phyir// shes rab dbang po rgyas pa yin/ ༈ /deng sang 'di na la la dag /skra bcas skra med bud med kyi// khyim thabs bdag tu bzung byas nas// bde ba chen po'i sgom zhes lo// khyim thab sdug bsngal rgyu yin phyir// bde chen sgom pa'i rten mi rung*// bcom ldan phrin las phyag rgya ni// mi mo'i lus la mtshan dpe ldan// mchog gi sprul sku yin pa'i phyir// khyim thabs bdag 'dzin yul ma yin// de phyir de la sngags skyes dang*// zhing skyes rigs skyes la sogs pa// rnal 'byor can la snang rung gi

/rnal 'byor med la snang ma yin// mi gtsang phung po las rgya min// sdug phung 'di la byin rlabs med/ ༈ /blo gros chung ngu'i rnam rtog la// khyim pa rdor 'dzin bshad pa'i phyir// khyim thab la sogs spyod pa yang*// gsang sngags lam la rung ngo lo// dge bsnyen tsam gyi brten la ni// sngags spyod rung bar bshad pa yang*// tshangs spyod dge bsnyen nyid du gsal// khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa yang*// sprul pa'i gang zag rnams la dgongs// bdag ni 'khrig pa'i bde ba dang*// de nyid lam du ston pa yi// dam chos bla mar bcas pa kun// skye ba kun tu mthong ma 'gyur// 'di nas 'chi 'phos gyur pa na// dga' ldan mi pham mdun drung du// the tshom mtha' dag legs chod de// 'jig rten rab rib sel byed shog /chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i gtam// sgom pa'i le'u gnyis pa'o// ༈ //thar pa sgrub par 'dod pa dag /lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa kun// sdom pa'i dge rtsas zin pa dgos// des na sdom pa'i rnam gzhag kun// theg pa rang rang so so nas// ji ltar bstan bzhin bslab par gyis/ ༈ /kha cig dge ba bcu spyod na// sdom pa tshul bzhin ma blangs kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sdom pa ste// cho ga gzhan dag mi dgos lo// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yi// sdom pa'i rnam par bzhag pa la// rags pa brda yis blangs pa dang*// phra ba chos nyid kyis thob pa// gnyis las gzhan du med pa la// rags pa brda byung dbang du na// cho ga'i sgo nas ma blangs pa'i// dge ba'ang bar ma tsam yin gyis// bde gshegs bstan pa'i sdom pa min/ ༈ /kha cig sems nyid rtogs thabs la// sdom pa bsrungs bar byed pa yin// sems nyid rtogs pa'i dus der nas// sdom pa sbun pa bzhin du grol// sdom pa sems nyid ye srung lo// sdom pa so so rang rang gi /gtong rgyus gtong bar ma byas na// chos nyid mthong bas ci ste gtong*// ye srung yin na thob shor med/

༈ /deng sang 'di na cher rlom 'ga'// sdig pa bab col spyod bzhin du// byang sems spyod pa yin pa'i phyir// sdom gsum gang la'ang nyes med lo// byang chub sems dpa' las dang pos// nyes spyod gtso cher sdom dgos na// sdig pa byed pa ga la srid// byang sems rab dga'i sa la sogs// bzhugs pa rnams kyis 'khor los bsgyur// rgyal po la sogs lus 'dzin nas// sems can kun don mdzad pa la// mtshon gyi chad pa la sogs pa'i// kha na ma tho'i dri ma bral/ ༈ /kha cig chags sdang spyod pa yang*// drag po'i 'phrin las yin pa dang*// nged kyi dge ba'i mdzad pa yang*// khyod kyi skal pa'i nyes pa yis// mi dge ba ru mthong ngo lo// drag po'i 'phrin las zhes pa ni// skal ba mchog tu gyur rnams la// gnyen po myur du 'dren pa dang*// spang bya myur spong las la zer// chags sdang spyod pa 'dor phyir yin// khams dwangs pa yis snang mthun ngor// snang ba mi 'drar ston nus na// nged kyi skal ba'i nyes par srid// snang mthun kun gyi snang tshul la// sdig spyod 'ba' zhig grub pa'i phyir// 'di ni dge ba e yin nam/ ༈ /kha cig so thar sdom ldan gyis// rab byung cha lugs 'dzin dgos bzhin// rig 'dzin sdom la gnas pa yang*// he ru ka yi cha lugs ni// mi tshe ril por byed pas na// dud 'gro la sogs bsad na yang*// nyes med sha ba ri bzhin lo// de gnyis mtshungs pa ma yin te// de bzhin gshegs pa rang nyid kyi// rab byung so thar sdom ldan la// rnam pa kun tu rab byung gi /cha lugs 'dzin par ston pas bcas// rig 'dzin sdom ldan kun la yang*// he ru ka yi cha lugs ni// thun mong skye bo thams cad ngor// 'dzin par mi rung ston pas bcas// sha ba ri pas sprul pa'i phag /bsad tshul yin gyis rang rgyud min// 'di na khyim thab sbrel ba la// sngon gyi lung bstan yod pa dang*// lung stong kun tu brgyus nas ni// gnas sgo gsar du 'byed ces dang*// yi dam zhal gzigs rtogs chos 'chad// he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma// rigs gsum mgon po la sogs kyi// sku skyer khas len byed pa sogs// rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus 'di ru// bdud kyis byas pa min na rung*// sangs rgyas mi lpags gon pa dang*// zog pos blun po bslu ba gnyis// shes rab can la ga la 'dra// chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i gtam// spyod pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o//

༈ //mchog gi dngos grub 'bras bu ni// dbang bzhis smin cing phyag rgya bzhis// bskyed cing stong bzhi dga' bzhi dang*// snang bzhi'i ngo bor myong ba yis// skad cig gcig dang mngon byang lnga// rnam pa nyi shu sgyu dra yi// mngon byang chub pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku bzhi'i ngo bor grub pa'o// karma rang byung zhabs nyid kyis// zab mo nang don brjod don du// thams cad mkhyen gzigs sgra bzlos zer// ji lta ji snyed ye shes kyi// bden pa gnyis po kun mkhyen cing*// de yang yul gyi bden pa gnyis// yul can tshad mas mngon sum du// gzigs pa'i phyir na sgra zlos med/ ༈ /thams cad mkhyen dang ye shes sku// gnyis la tshig zlos yod do lo// thams cad mkhyen dang ye shes sku// bde chen sdom par ro gcig kyang*// nyan rang lugs las khyad 'byed pa'i// tshig la rnam bcad yongs gcod yod/ ༈ /ye shes sku ni mun pa dang*// bral phyir nyin mor byed bzlos lo// sems tsam pa yi ye shes sku// rnam par shes la gzhag pa ni// bsal phyir rnam shes mun pa dang*// bral phyir nyin mor byed ces brjod/ ༈ /gal te pad 'dab rgyas pa'i spyan// mnga' na ye shes sku sogs kyang*// gzugs can nyid du thal lo smra// dpe la 'khrul bar mi bya yi// gzugs kyi dmigs cig ston pa min// chags thogs bral ba'i thugs rje la// pad 'dab spyan du btags pa yin/ ༈ /kha cig zla grags dgongs pa zhes// sangs rgyas la ni ye shes med// bems pos gzhan don byed pa ni// mkha' lding mchod sdong bzhin no lo// rnam shes gnas par gyur na yang*// 'du byed dag gis ma bsgrubs pa'i// stong nyid ye shes bsam mi khyab// ye shes med na stobs sogs kyi// yon tan phrin las ci la gzhag /phung khams skye mched kun spangs nas// sangs rgyas bems por ga la srid// khyab bdag rgyun chad med pa yi// 'phrin las mnga' ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// bdag ni 'di la snying nas dad// chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i gtam// 'bras bu'i skabs te bzhi pa'o//

༈ //mchog gi dbang phyug mnga' ba yi// thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas rje// mnyan pa grub thob zhes bya ba'i// tshad ldan rdo rje'i bka' 'di ni// srid pa'i 'jigs pa gcod pa'i phyir// lam 'di khyod la ngas bshad pas// khyod kyis cis kyang sgrub par byos// de bzhin gshegs gsungs tshad ma yin// bdag gi sde snod gsum po shes// rgyud sde bzhi yi phyogs tsam mthong*// rdo rje 'dzin pa mgu bar byas// 'khrul pa bral ba'i mig bu thob// bde gshegs brgyud pa'i man ngag ldan// sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig bla mar brgyud// dam chos tshul bzhin rgyud la longs// snying rje bzod med nang nas skyes// phyogs lhung zhen bral mos gus yod// dgag sgrub rnam gzhag 'di kun kyang*// rmongs pas kun nas bslangs pa yi// rnam par rtog pa yod re skan// rnal 'byor can 'ga'i dgongs pa can// gsungs rnams log par 'chad mthong nas// rnal 'byor can gyis gsungs 'ga' zhig /phyogs snga lta bur bkod na yang*// 'khyog po'i shing bzhin 'dir bkug nas// rnal 'byor chen po'i dgongs pa rnams// sangs rgyas gsung dang mi 'gal bar// bdag gis zab mo'i man ngag tu// rgya cher bshad pa rnams su ltos// rtogs ldan brgyud pa'i myong ba yis// don dam bden pa'i gnas lugs phye// shes bya mkhas par sbyangs pa'i mthus// kun rdzob bden pa'i snang tshul shes// snying nas thar pa 'dod pa la// kun mkhyen go 'phang sbyin tshul shes// gsol ba gsha' mar 'debs pa la// thugs rje byin gyis rlobs pa yin// ༈ //'khor ba'i gnas 'dir rmongs pa mtha' yas pas// 'gro ba long bar gyur pa de dag kun// sgrib bral mkhas pa'i drung du bden bzhi'i don// shes bya kun la sgro 'dogs chod par bgyis// cung zad shes nas rang la nga rgyal dang*// gzhan la log lta gzhan skyon brjod pa dang*// rang bstod la sogs las su ma rungs pa'i// blo gros ngan pa'i dri ma kun spangs nas// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas pa'i// lam gyi snying po kho nar 'bad pa las// bsam rgyu gzhan du med pa'i go khur te// mgo thod me 'bar bshugs pa'i brtson 'grus ltar// byang chub spyod pa'i thabs shes sbyang bar gyis// tha snyad la ni snying po med pa'i phyir// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i 'dod pa gtan btang nas// bla ma sangs rgyas zhig gi zhabs drung du// rang rgyud gyong po ma 'di e khugs ltos// 'dir 'bad dge ba gang thob khams gsum bde ba 'di// ro ltar rtogs nas snying rje chen pos sems can kun// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog la 'god nus pa'i// dbang phyug sems can kun la snyoms par thob pa nas// bdag ni lhag par sangs rgyas mnyan pa chen po yi// bka' yi dgongs pa ji bzhin 'khor bar 'khyams gyur cig

/ces bya ba 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa karma pa yi mtshan gyi byin rlabs dang ldan pa// tshe rabs snga ma dang phyi ma mthong ba'i mig can// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan chab kyis nyin re bzhin khrus bgyid pa// sangs rgyas mnyan pa chen po dang skad cig kyang 'bral ba med pa rnal 'byor pa chen po'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa rdo rje'i dbyangs a la la la la la hor sgrogs pas sbyar ba'o/// /
